translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Ubbaappe Wolk'k'aama Med'ina Goday, «Be'ite, ta biyaa ogiyaa giigissanaadan, taani kiittiyaa asaa kasetaade yeddana; k'ay hintte koyiyaa Godaykka hintte k'oppennaan de'ishshin, bare Geeshsha Golliyaa puttu gaana. Hintte nashettiyaa, k'aalaa c'aak'uwaa kiitanchchay yaana» yaagee.

Shin I biraanne work'k'aa siilissiide geeshshiyaa tamaa malanne mayuwaa meec'c'iyaa saamonaa mala gidiyaa diraw, I yiyaa gallassi danddayanawe oonee? K'ay I k'onc'c'iyaa wode Aa sintsan ek'k'anaw danddayiyaawe oonee?
I biraanne work'k'aa geeshshiyaawaadaaninne tigiyaawaadan uttiide, Leewiyaa zaratuwaa geeshshana; unttunttu Med'ina Godaw likke yarshshuwaa yarshshana gakkanaw, I unttuntta geeshshana.
Yaatooppe beni wodetuwaadaninne aad'd'eedda laytsatuwaadan, Yihudaa asaynne Yerusaalame Asay yarshshiyaa yarshshuu Med'ina Godaa nashechchiyaawaa gidanawaa.

Ubbaappe Wolk'k'aama Med'ina Goday, «Hewaappe guyyiyaan, taani pirddaa pirddanaw hinttekko yaade, muruniyaawanttu bolla, woshummiyaawanttu bolla, wordduwaan c'aak'k'iyaawanttu bolla, oosanchchatoo bessiyaa dirgguwaa immennan diggiyaawanttu bolla, asinay hayk'k'eedda am"attonne aata aawuu hayk'k'eedda naanatuwaa tuggayiyaawanttu bolla, betiyaa pirddaa geellayiyaawanttu bollanne taw yayyenawanttu bolla ellekka markkattana» yaagee.
Asiraataa Imotaa
K'aykka Ubbaappe Wolk'k'aama Med'ina Goday, «Taani Med'ina Goday laamettikke; hewaa diraw, hinttenoo Yaak'ooba zaretoo, hintte d'aykkita.

Hintte mayzza aawotuwaa wodiyaappe doommiide, hintte ta wogaappe wora simmeeddita; aakka naagibeykkita. Ha"i taakko simmite; taanikka hinttekko simmana» yaagee. Shin hintte, «Nuuni waan simmanne?» yaagiide oochchiita.

Med'ina Goday, «Asay Med'ina Godaa wuu"ii? Shin hintte taana wuu"iita» yaagee. K'aykka hintte, «Nuuni neena wooti wuu"eettoo? yaagiita» yaagee. Ubbaappe Wolk'k'aama S'oossay, «Hintte asiraataaninne imotaan taana wuu"iita.
Hintte Israa'eeliyaa Asay ubbay taana wuu"iyaa diraw, hintte shek'etteeddawaantta.
Ta Geeshsha Golliyaan k'umay de'anaadan, asiraataa ubbaa yeesiyaan yeggite. Yaatiide taani saluwaa maskkootiyaa dooyaade anjjuwaa hinttenttoo palahissaade gussana d'ayooppe, taana hewan paac'c'ite.

Hintte biittay mokkiyaa katsaa bayzzenaadan, taani hintte diraw katsaa bayizziyaabaa ubbaa seerana; gaden de'iyaa woyniyaa turaykka ayifiyaa diggenna. Taani Ubbaappe Wolk'k'aama Med'ina Goday hawaa oday.
Hintte biittay de'anaw nashechchiyaa biittaa gidiyaa diraw, kawutetsatuu ubbay hinttena, ‹Anjjetteeddawantta› yaagana» yaagee.
Med'ina Goday Bare AsaaMaaranaw Odeedda K'aalaa
Med'ina Goday hawaadan yaagee; «Hintte ta bolla s'ala k'aalaa haasayeeddita. «Yaatiide k'ay, ‹Nuuni ne bolla waagi haasayeeddo?› yaagiide oochchiita.
«K'aykka hintte, ‹S'oossaw ootsiyaawe hada. Aa azazuwaa naagiyaawaaninne Ubbaappe Wolk'k'aama Med'ina Godaa sintsan kayyottiide hamettiyaawan nuuni ayaa go"etteettoo?
Nuuni otorettiyaawanttu anjjettiina be'eetto; iitaa ootsiyaawanttukka ishaliide de'iyaawaa s'alalaa gidennaan, S'oossaa paac'c'iiddekka kessi akkiino› yaagiita» yaagee.

He wode Med'ina Godaw yayyiyaawanttu ittuu ittuwaanna haasayeeddino; Med'ina Godaykka hayzziide siseedda. Med'ina Godaw yayyeeddawanttunne Aa suntsaakka bonchcheeddawantta hassayissiyaa mas'aafay Aa sintsan s'aafetteedda.

Ubbaappe Wolk'k'aama Med'ina Goday, «Unttunttu tawaa gidanawantta; taani ootsiyaa gallassi unttunttu taw dummateedda asaa gidanawantta; aawuu barew ootsiyaa bare na'aa maariyaawaadan, taani unttuntta maarana.
He wode hintte zaaretsiidekka s'illuwaappenne nagaranchchaappe gidduwaan de'iyaa zawaanne S'oossaw azazettiyaawanttuppenne azazettenawanttuppe gidduwaan de'iyaa zawaa be'ana» yaagee.
